# sloper in polar form: zenith angle and length, both from the top end (the
# length about the centre would move the top end off the mast, so the two
# would not add up the same either way round); SWR and a low elevation
file SLOPER.MAA
weights 0 0 0 100 30 0 0
minswr 1.1
set 0 wirep 1 6
var 0 pitch=1 min=20 max=80
set 1 wirep 1 0
limit 200
